## Option order (Strands Decider)

The project options were rotated 7 ways (with 7 options, each option listed first once) over 30 canonical tasks: 2 task(s) changed answer, a flip rate of **6.7%**. The first-listed option was chosen in 29 of 210 answers (13.8%; an order-blind model rotated through every order picks the first-listed option 1 time in 7, 14.3%). Threshold for the mitigation (`other` first, the rest alphabetical): above 10%, not exceeded. Carried over from `rotation-2026-10-20T0015UTC.jsonl` rather than measured in this run: only the project answer is rotated, and the canonical tasks and project options are the same. It was measured with today's wording of the project question. Run conditions: another long-running Bedrock experiment on the same laptop paused; the laptop otherwise idle; Decider at below-normal priority, 4 threads, restarted every 10 tasks, --max-commit-gb 16, 600 s per read.
